title: Playboy's College Girls 1983 Newsstand Special Ivy League Big Ten Pac 10 SEC
conditionDescription: Covers clean and bright with no creases or tears; spine intact. Light edge wear. Complete. See photos.
descriptionText:
Playboy's College Girls - 1983 newsstand special (issue code 38580 093). Original $3.95 cover price (Canada $4.50, U.K. 3.25 pounds).

Girls of the Southwest Conference, Big Eight, Big Ten, Ivy League, Southeastern Conference and Pac 10. Back cover: "Major subjects from campuses across the country."

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
